data.name: Giantess Survival Simulator
data.detailed_description:
A Survival Sandbox Where Size is Everything

Ever wanted to survive in a multiplayer world where you can grow into a towering giantess, or shrink down so smol that everything becomes a threat? Everything in GSS is hand crafted to hit on every part of that fantasy. And most importantly?

Giantesses that are not just eye candy but are actually POWERFUL enough to affect everything on your server from crushing player bases with a finger to causing weather events. Grow immense and Dominate the server. Or stay small and survive in the shadows of giants.

🎮 Core Features

  • NPC Giantess growth system: make offerings and watch them become immense and powerful

  • Player size changing Macromancy magic to grow and shrink

  • Resource gathering, crafting, and base building with multiple sized progression tiers

  • Massive open world to explore and build bases to call home

  • Built for multiplayer from day one

💬 Join Development NOW

GSS is being solo developed with community support. The Discord is public and active right now, where you can:

  • Vote on features and development priorities through regular polls

  • Share ideas and provide direct feedback

  • Get exclusive behind the scenes updates and previews

Whether you're here for the survival mechanics, the massive girls, or both, your voice matters in shaping this game. Wishlist & Join Discord to be part of building Giantess Survival Simulator! 💜

data.short_description: Giantess Survival Simulator is the multiplayer giantess playground game where size is everything! Gather, craft, and build bases to Grow yourself into a massive giantess or Shrink to survive in their shadow. Join our community to vote for features and priorities for this indie UE5 passion project!

content_descriptors.notes: This game features size based domination interactions and is intended for mature audiences.
